issues.evidence: A pure canonical incidence-index builder now exposes deterministic vertex/hyperedge order, prototype-safe bidirectional Map/Set relations, canonical record references, counts, and safe query helpers without persistent projected neighbors or independent mutation state.

contracts.sourceOfTruth: The canonical hyperedge array remains authoritative; the index is derived and has no mutation API or cache.
contracts.ordering: Hyperedges follow canonical array order; vertices use first-seen canonical order; hyperedge memberships preserve first-seen canonical membership order; incident hyperedges follow canonical hyperedge order.
contracts.identifiers: The public builder accepts already-canonical exact string identifiers only. It reuses the Stage 1 identifier validator and rejects input that would require normalization.
contracts.malformedInput: Null, undefined, non-array input, malformed records, missing IDs, duplicate hyperedge IDs, non-array membership, and noncanonical identifiers fail clearly.
contracts.duplicates: Duplicate membership is deduplicated in derived Set relations without mutating the source array.
contracts.metadata: hyperedgesById references the canonical hyperedge record; time, weight, attributes, and vertex arrays are neither cloned nor rewritten.
contracts.invalidation: No cache exists in Stage 3. Callers rebuild from the current canonical array after existing graph identity/version changes.
contracts.complexity: Construction is O(H + V + I) and creates no H2H/V2V pairs or projected-neighbor state.

deferredConsumers.note: Existing consumers and resolver-specific rebuilds remain unchanged until their explicitly authorized migration stages.
